Heading: Security & Trust
Intro: A stable page for procurement and data-protection teams. We only state what we can actually stand behind today — no badges we haven't earned, and we don't overpromise.

Claims.Heading: Your data stays yours
Claims.Body: We don't sell your data or share it without your instruction. You control who sees a compliance pack.

Claims.Heading: Access is controlled
Claims.Body: Accounts are authenticated, and each organisation only ever sees its own data.

Claims.Heading: Encrypted in transit
Claims.Body: Traffic to and from Tedwren is encrypted using standard transport security.

Claims.Heading: A record you can review
Claims.Body: Key actions are logged so there's an audit trail your team can check.

Claims.Heading: Data-protection questions welcome
Claims.Body: Contact us for a DPA or to walk through how we handle personal data — we'd rather answer early.

MetaDescription: How Tedwren handles your data and access: the security practices we can stand behind today, written plainly for procurement and data-protection teams.
